def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize sex label variants (MALE/FEMALE -> male/female); leave missing as unknown
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('string').str.strip().str.lower()
    df.loc[~df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']), 'sex'] = pd.NA
    # body_mass_g written as text (with thousands separators) -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype('string').str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # flipper_length_mm may contain text / negative or out-of-range values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[~df['flipper_length_mm'].between(170, 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    # also coerce other numeric columns defensively
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'year']:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 4) for k, v in g.items()}
